marketNotes.text: Spain has enough sellers for its own price layer: over 20 Spain-serving sellers (Spanish shops, EU shops with Spanish storefronts, Amazon.es and PcComponentes marketplaces). Lines that still need the German fallback: LTO-10 40TB (one listing), LTO-9 and LTO-10 WORM (two each), LTO-6 drives, and all LTO-10 drives.
No standalone LTO-10 drive is listed at any Spain-serving seller checked. LTO-10 drives appear only inside Qualstar libraries at Neovideo.

HPE LTO-9 drives cost far more than Quantum in Spain: BC040A is €15,594 (Bechtle) and €17,347 (Senetic), P84142-B25 is €15,471 (Bechtle), while Quantum TC-L92AN-BR is €11,581 (Bixoto). Senetic's BC042A at €6,685 is an outlier and needs an availability check.
Bechtle ES sells only to businesses and public bodies. Its pages lead with the net price and show the gross price beside it; the gross (IVA incl.) figure is recorded.
Neovideo and MasQueVideo (broadcast resellers in Barcelona) show prices without IVA; these are recorded as shown with vatIncluded false.

idealo.es prices include IVA but not shipping. Offers from ManoMano, eBay, OnBuy and Miravia marketplace sellers were left out because they sit well above retail: HPE Q2078A ran €112.53 to €154.99 there, against €72.43 to €104.46 at shops.
PCBox, Beep and App Informática list identical prices. PCBox blocks bots on its own site, so its prices come from idealo.es.
Bixoto shows most LTO items as a special offer against a list price; those datapoints carry the note 'sale'.

MagStor and Symply drives are sold in Spain only as Thunderbolt or USB desktop units, so they are left out of the SAS drive lines. Example: Symply SY-SYPRO-DT3L9H1B LTO-9 Thunderbolt at €9,099 excl. IVA (MasQueVideo).
No Sony LTO media was found at any Spain-serving seller.
